originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
User actor as "User"
App participant as "App"
AuthService participant as "AuthService"
SMSGateway participant as "SMSGateway"

msg_1 = User -#> App as "enter phone number"
msg_2 = App -#> AuthService as "request OTP"
msg_3 = AuthService -#> SMSGateway as "send OTP code"
msg_4 = SMSGateway -.-> User as "deliver OTP via SMS"
msg_5 = User -#> App as "enter OTP code"
msg_6 = App -#> AuthService as "verify OTP"
msg_7 = AuthService -.-> App as "OTP valid"
